question: An electron is accelerated from rest through a potential difference of 5000 V. Calculate its de Broglie wavelength. (h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, m = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.)

mark_scheme: 1 mark: Resonant amplitude is reduced. Accept: reduces; decreases; smaller; lower; less; amplitude falls. Do not accept: increases; bigger; larger. Allow any wording that conveys the idea, including common alternatives, correct hedged answers ('I think ...') and clearly intended spelling. Ignore extra correct detail. No mark if the idea is negated, contradicted, or the response gives two different answers.
model_answer: Damping removes energy from the oscillator so the resonant amplitude is smaller and the resonance peak is flatter.
common_misconceptions: Students say damping increases the amplitude.

question: Which definition best describes Time constant?

options.text: The time taken for the charge on a capacitor to halve.
The time taken for the charge on a discharging capacitor to fall to 1/e (about 37%) of its initial value, equal to the product of the resistance and capacitance.
The time taken for a capacitor to discharge completely.
The time taken for a capacitor to charge to its maximum value.

option_feedback.A: This is the half-life of the discharge.
option_feedback.C: A capacitor never discharges completely in a finite time.
option_feedback.D: This is not the time constant.

answer: B — The time taken for the charge on a discharging capacitor to fall to 1/e (about 37%) of its initial value, equal to the product of the resistance and capacitance.
